story_theme_en: A fruit shop sells mangosteen at 12.75 kg at 85.50 baht per kilogram, and oranges at 8.50 kg at 42.25 baht per kilogram. How much do both cost in total? If the customer pays with 1,000 baht, how much change will they receive?
